design_brief_zh: 主卖点是干湿分离：用打开的YWJ 13A旅行箱展示涤纶内衬中的干湿分离袋，直观表现湿衣与干衣分开收纳的使用收益；不添加未经提供的防水或密封承诺。PC画布1464×600，左侧文案区严格使用[x,y,w,h]=[0.05,0.1,0.38,0.8]，右侧产品区使用[0.49,0.08,0.46,0.84]；PC阅读顺序为标题、支持说明、证据细节1、证据细节2，从左上向左下，再看右侧产品。标题对应干湿分离主功能，支持说明对应干湿衣物分开收纳的收益，细节1对应侧面四个挂钩，细节2对应顶部一个金属挂钩。右侧以三分之二打开的箱体为主体，同时安排表面竖条纹纹路特写与铝合金框架铰链局部，展示现代外观和结构细节；可在箱体旁放置干衣、湿衣两组服装及少量袋子，清楚表现使用场景。移动端画布1200×900，产品区位于上方[0.08,0.05,0.84,0.53]，文案区位于底部[0.05,0.64,0.9,0.31]；移动阅读顺序为上方场景先看产品与干湿分离袋，再从底部标题、支持说明、两个细节依次阅读。采用欧洲现代旅行摄影、低饱和中性色和自然光，产品边缘清晰，避免过度反光；使用Arial、Helvetica或Amazon Ember风格无衬线字体，标题加粗，正文和数字高对比、易读，并为德语文本预留约20%横向扩展空间。
compliance_note_zh: 仅使用已提供的干湿分离袋、侧面四个挂钩和顶部一个金属挂钩事实；不宣称防水、密封、测试、认证、官方背书或绝对耐用性。画面不得出现竞品商标、虚构评分、促销角标或未经证实的容量与尺寸信息。
image_prompt_en: Create a premium European-modern travel photography A+ banner for a YWJ 13A travel suitcase, with no rendered text, letters, numbers, logos, badges, or watermarks. PC composition 1464x600: place the open suitcase and product details on the right, occupying approximately x=0.49 to 0.95 and y=0.08 to 0.92; leave the left 38% as a clean, quiet background area for later copy placement. Mobile composition 1200x900: place the suitcase scene in the upper 53% and leave the lower 31% clean for later copy. Show the suitcase three-quarters open with its polyester interior and a clear dry-wet separation bag: dry folded clothing on one side, a separate group of damp travel garments on the other, without implying waterproofing. Include a visible side detail with four hooks holding several small bags, plus the single upper metal hook holding one essential item. Also show a tasteful close-up inset or foreground detail of the vertical striped shell texture and the aluminum frame hinge, emphasizing refined construction without making unsupported durability claims. Match the supplied product appearance: hard-shell suitcase with vertical ribbed surface, aluminum frame, four corner protectors, and neutral silver or gunmetal styling. Use soft natural window light, low-saturation neutral colors, realistic material texture, clean studio-travel setting, crisp edges, restrained shadows, and an upscale but credible German-market aesthetic. Keep the reserved copy areas uncluttered and maintain strong PC-to-mobile readability.
